resources.string: ObsiLauncher is an unofficial, modified version of a GPL-3.0 open-source launcher project. It is not affiliated with, or supported by, the original authors.
Game rendering on this device is powered by MobileGlues.
A fast, glass-styled Minecraft: Java Edition launcher — free for everyone, no keys, no limits.
The game renders on this device through MobileGlues.
ObsiLauncher is free and open-source software. You can use, study, share and improve it — every version is unlocked, no access key required.
